$comment: Extensions crow ships as BUILT-INS in every packaged tree, so the notebook
kernel picker and the Python interpreter/environment pickers work out of the
box -- in the desktop app AND in `crow serve-web`. No marketplace install, no
first-run network, nothing for the user to discover.
bundle-exts.sh downloads each pinned vsix from `gallery` (cached under
<tree>/extensions/<publisher>.<name>, which is where VS Code scans
built-ins from. Bump a version here and re-run ./build.sh (or
./bundle-exts.sh on its own) to pick it up.
targetPlatform 'auto' resolves to <os>-<arch> at build time (linux-x64 for
the default build); omit the key for universal vsix builds. Open VSX's
ms-python.vscode-pylance is deliberately absent: it is Microsoft-licensed and
not published to Open VSX. Everything else the ms-python / ms-toolsai
extension packs pull in is here.
